products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a range of banking products and services to business and corporate customers, including commercial loans (real estate, construction, equipment financing), deposit products, treasury management, and corporate credit cards. Delivery is through physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Offers retail banking products and services to individuals, such as checking, savings, and time deposit accounts, ATM services, internet and mobile banking, overdraft facilities, consumer loans (including real estate and home equity), credit cards, and safe deposit boxes. Delivered via branch network and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides mortgage loans to individuals for home purchases and refinancing, including origination and servicing. Requires regulatory compliance, underwriting, and is delivered through both in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Small Business and Agricultural Lending
products.description: Offers specialized lending products to small businesses and agricultural enterprises, including SBA loans and agricultural finance. Delivered through branch network and requires regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides trust, investment management, agency, and custodial services for individuals and corporate clients, including estate administration and investment account management. Delivered by specialized staff and digital platforms, requiring regulatory oversight.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers securities brokerage services to customers through a third-party broker-dealer arrangement. Delivered via referral and partnership, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides personal and corporate insurance products through wholly-owned insurance agency subsidiaries. Delivered by licensed agents and requires regulatory compliance.

products.name: Generic Medicines
products.description: Teva develops, manufactures, and sells generic medicines in various dosage forms (tablets, capsules, injectables, inhalants, liquids, transdermal patches, ointments, creams) globally. These are chemical and therapeutic equivalents to originator medicines, produced in compliance with regulatory standards and delivered through a global manufacturing and distribution network.

products.name: Biosimilar Medicines
products.description: Teva commercializes biosimilar medicines, which are highly similar to reference biologic drugs, in partnership with other companies. These products are manufactured using advanced biotechnological processes and are distributed globally, often through strategic collaborations.

products.name: Innovative Medicines
products.description: Teva develops and markets proprietary, branded medicines, primarily in the therapeutic areas of central nervous system (CNS), respiratory, and oncology. These medicines are produced through in-house R&D, manufactured in specialized facilities, and delivered globally, often with associated patient support programs.

products.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Products
products.description: Teva offers a range of OTC pharmaceutical products, including global and regional brands, manufactured in compliance with regulatory standards and distributed through retail and pharmacy channels worldwide.

products.name: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API)
products.description: Teva produces and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients to third parties, utilizing various production technologies (chemical synthesis, fermentation, etc.) in dedicated facilities. APIs are supplied globally for use in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Teva provides contract manufacturing services for pharmaceutical products, leveraging its global manufacturing network and expertise in various dosage forms and technologies. These services are offered to external customers, including products divested from Teva's own portfolio.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution Services (Anda)
products.description: Through its Anda business, Teva distributes generic, biosimilar, innovative, and OTC medicines from Teva and third-party manufacturers to pharmacies, hospitals, and physician offices in the United States, utilizing a broad product portfolio and nationwide delivery infrastructure.

products.name: Out-Licensing Platform (Medis)
products.description: Teva, through its affiliate Medis, offers an out-licensing platform, providing a portfolio of pharmaceutical products to other pharmaceutical companies for commercialization in various markets.

products.name: Liquids Pipelines Services
products.description: Transportation, storage, and export of crude oil and other liquid hydrocarbons via an extensive network of pipelines and terminals in Canada and the US. Services are provided under long-term contracts and regulated tolling frameworks, requiring significant physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Natural Gas Transmission and Storage Services
products.description: Transmission, gathering, processing, and storage of natural gas through a network of pipelines and storage facilities in Canada and the US. Services are provided under firm and interruptible agreements, supported by regulated cost-of-service models and long-term contracts, requiring large-scale regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Canada and the US through regulated utility operations. This includes delivery, transportation, and storage of natural gas via extensive pipeline networks and storage assets, under regulatory oversight and rate frameworks.

products.name: Renewable Power Generation
products.description: Generation and sale of electricity from wind, solar, and geothermal power facilities in North America and Europe. Power is primarily sold under long-term power purchase agreements, with assets requiring significant capital investment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Crude Oil Marketing Services
products.description: Physical commodity marketing and logistical services for crude oil, including transportation and storage arrangements for refiners, producers, and other customers. This business leverages both Enbridge-owned and third-party assets to capture value from market differentials.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production and Supply
products.description: Production and supply of renewable natural gas derived from organic waste sources, including landfill gas-to-RNG facilities and investments in RNG infrastructure. RNG is integrated into existing natural gas infrastructure and offered as a lower-carbon energy solution.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule GPCR-Targeted Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of orally administered small molecule drugs designed to modulate G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) for the treatment of diseases in endocrinology, immunology and inflammation, and metabolic diseases. These therapeutics are discovered and developed using a proprietary structure-based drug design platform and are delivered as oral medications following pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule PTH1R Agonists for Hypoparathyroidism
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs that selectively activate the parathyroid hormone 1 receptor (PTH1R) to treat hypoparathyroidism, offering a non-injectable alternative to hormone replacement. These are developed through structure-based drug design and manufactured for oral administration.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule MRGPRX2 Negative Allosteric Modulators for Mast Cell-Driven Diseases
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs that inhibit the MRGPRX2 receptor, targeting mast cell activation to treat diseases such as chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) and potentially other mast cell-driven conditions. These are discovered using proprietary screening and optimization technologies and are delivered as oral medications.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule TSHR Negative Allosteric Modulators for Graves’ Disease and Thyroid Eye Disease
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs that inhibit the thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR) to treat Graves’ disease and thyroid eye disease (TED), aiming to provide a disease-modifying, non-surgical therapy. These are developed using structure-based drug design and are intended for oral administration.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule GPCR-Targeted Therapies for Metabolic Diseases (in collaboration with Novo Nordisk)
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs targeting multiple GPCRs (including GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors) for the treatment of metabolic diseases such as obesity and type-2 diabetes. These are developed through a collaboration with Novo Nordisk, leveraging the proprietary drug discovery platform, and are intended for oral administration.

products.name: Specialty Alcohols
products.description: Produced via wet and dry milling processes at company facilities, these include industrial-, pharmaceutical-, and food- and beverage-grade alcohols, such as API-grade, USP-grade, and grain neutral spirits, sold to health, home & beauty, food & beverage, and industrial markets. Products are distributed in bulk and break bulk quantities, with stringent quality certifications.

products.name: Renewable Fuels (Fuel-Grade Ethanol)
products.description: Produced at company and third-party facilities, fuel-grade ethanol is manufactured primarily via dry milling and sold as a transportation fuel additive to oil companies and gasoline marketers. Includes ISCC-certified ethanol for export and is distributed via truck, rail, barge, and terminaling services.

products.name: Essential Ingredients (Animal and Pet Feed)
products.description: Co-products from alcohol production, such as dried yeast, corn protein meal, corn protein feed, distillers grains (WDGS, DDGS), and liquid feed, are further processed and sold as high-protein animal and pet feed ingredients to dairies, feedlots, and food manufacturers.

products.name: Corn Oil
products.description: Extracted during the wet milling process, corn oil is sold as a feedstock for renewable diesel and biodiesel production, as well as to poultry and other industrial customers. Production involves specialized separation and refining equipment.

products.name: Liquid and Gaseous Carbon Dioxide (CO2)
products.description: CO2 is captured as a byproduct of alcohol production, processed into liquid and gaseous forms at dedicated facilities, and sold for use in beverage carbonation, dry ice, food processing, and industrial applications. Facilities are FSSC 22000 certified for food-grade CO2.

products.name: Yeast for Human Consumption
products.description: Yeast separated and dried during the wet milling process is further refined and sold as a food ingredient for human consumption, meeting food safety and quality certifications.

products.name: Powersports Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of new and pre-owned motorcycles, ATVs, side-by-side vehicles, personal watercraft, and other powersports vehicles sourced from OEMs and consumers, delivered through physical dealerships and online channels.

products.name: Parts, Apparel, and Accessories Sales
products.description: Retail sale of parts, apparel, and accessories for powersports vehicles, sourced from a wide range of manufacturers and delivered through dealership locations and online.

products.name: Finance and Insurance Products and Services
products.description: Provision of financing and insurance products related to powersports vehicle purchases, facilitated through dealership locations and partnerships with financial institutions.

products.name: Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of repair and maintenance services for powersports vehicles, delivered in-person at dealership service centers by specialized technicians.

products.name: Aftermarket Products Sales
products.description: Sale of aftermarket products for powersports vehicles, sourced from various manufacturers and offered through dealership locations.

products.name: Vehicle Transportation Brokerage Services (ceased 2025)
products.description: Previously provided asset-light transportation brokerage services facilitating automobile transportation between dealerships and auctions; operations ceased at the end of December 2025.

products.name: iPSC-Derived Beta Islet Cell Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic, off-the-shelf cell therapy product consisting of beta islet cells derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), engineered with proprietary immune-evasion technology and manufactured at scale for the treatment of type 1 diabetes and potentially other autoimmune diseases. Production involves scalable bioreactor-enabled differentiation, genetic engineering, and cryopreservation for immediate clinical use.

products.name: iPSC-Derived CAR T Cell Therapies (iT Cells)
products.description: Allogeneic, off-the-shelf chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapies derived from iPSCs, including CD19-targeted and dual-targeted (CD19/CD22) products, engineered with immune-evasion and other enhancements for the treatment of B-cell-mediated autoimmune diseases, hematologic malignancies, and solid tumors. Manufactured using scalable, feeder-free processes and advanced gene editing.

products.name: iPSC-Derived CAR NK Cell Therapies
products.description: Allogeneic, off-the-shelf natural killer (NK) cell therapies derived from iPSCs, including CD19-targeted CAR-iNK products, engineered with immune-evasion and persistence-supporting transgenes for the treatment of B-cell-mediated autoimmune diseases and potentially cancer. Manufactured using scalable processes and cryopreserved for immediate use.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial, commercial real estate (CRE), real estate construction, and agricultural loans, delivered through in-person banking centers and technology-based networks, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Offers consumer-focused banking products such as residential real estate loans, home equity lines of credit, consumer loans, demand and savings deposits, money transfers, safe deposit services, and individual retirement accounts, delivered via physical branches, ATMs, and digital platforms.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts for both consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, and money market accounts, supported by physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking infrastructure, and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Wealth Management and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Delivers asset management, investment management, trust and estate advisory, financial planning, business succession planning, employee retirement plan services, and fiduciary services to individuals, businesses, and foundations, requiring specialized human expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers brokerage-related services, including securities trading and investment products, through a third-party arrangement, delivered via Busey Investment Services, requiring regulatory compliance and partnership management.

products.name: Professional Farm Management Services
products.description: Provides farm management and brokerage services to the agricultural industry, involving in-person expertise and specialized knowledge in agricultural operations and land management.

products.name: Payment Technology Solutions
products.description: Delivers multi-channel payment processing and technology solutions for businesses, including mobile bill pay, interactive voice response, ACH, credit card networks, walk-in payment processing, lockbox remittance, billing, reconciliation, and treasury services, primarily through digital platforms and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Personal Computing Devices
products.description: HP designs and sells desktops, notebooks, workstations (including AI PCs), thin clients, retail point-of-sale systems, displays, and hybrid systems, primarily manufactured through outsourced partners and delivered via direct and channel sales.

products.name: Consumer Computing Devices and Accessories
products.description: HP provides consumer-focused PCs, gaming systems, and accessories, designed for personal, entertainment, and remote work use, manufactured externally and distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Lifecycle and Support Services for Computing Devices
products.description: HP offers lifecycle services such as support, deployment, configuration, and extended warranty for its computing devices, delivered through a combination of in-person and remote support infrastructure.

products.name: Endpoint Security Solutions
products.description: HP develops and sells security-enhanced PCs and printers, endpoint security software (for HP and non-HP devices), and endpoint security services, leveraging hardware and AI-based technologies, delivered digitally or embedded in devices.

products.name: Office Printing Solutions
products.description: HP manufactures and sells office printers, supplies, and related services and solutions for SMBs, public sector, and enterprises, including OEM hardware, distributed via direct and channel partners.

products.name: Home Printing Solutions
products.description: HP produces and sells home and small business printers, supplies, and related services, focusing on security and innovation, distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Graphics Printing Solutions
products.description: HP offers large-format, commercial, and industrial printing solutions and supplies, including printers and presses for print service providers and packaging converters, manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: 3D Printing and Additive Manufacturing Solutions
products.description: HP develops and sells 3D printers and additive manufacturing solutions, including supplies, for commercial and industrial customers, often in collaboration with partners, delivered as complete manufacturing solutions.

products.name: Printing Supplies and Consumables
products.description: HP sells consumable products such as ink and laser cartridges, media, industrial graphics supplies, and 3D printing supplies for recurring use in its hardware, manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to small and mid-sized industrial and commercial companies, including commercial real estate and commercial and industrial loans, secured by equipment, inventory, real estate, or other business assets. Delivered through in-person banking and subject to regulated underwriting standards.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers one- to four-family residential mortgages, including adjustable and fixed-rate loans, as well as warehouse lending to other mortgage lenders. Loans are secured by first lien mortgages and delivered through branch offices and digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides personal loans, automobile loans, mobile home and recreational vehicle loans, unsecured credit card receivables, and home equity lines of credit to individuals. Delivered through branch offices and Loan Central locations, with underwriting based on income, credit, and collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a range of deposit accounts including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, and individual retirement accounts. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking, with FDIC insurance and participation in the IntraFi Network for expanded coverage.

products.name: Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Provides trust administration, estate settlement, guardianship, and investment agency services, acting as trustee, executor, administrator, or agent for clients. Delivered through the Bank’s trust department with in-person and advisory support.

products.name: Internet and Digital Banking Services
products.description: Offers online banking, bill payment, account management, cash management, and related digital services, enabling customers to manage finances, transfer funds, and access information remotely. Delivered via web and digital platforms.

products.name: Tax Refund Advance Loans and Tax Preparation Services
products.description: Provides short-term tax refund advance loans (TALs) to tax preparation customers, along with seasonal tax preparation services through Loan Central. Delivered in-branch and coordinated with IRS refund processing.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Acts as a licensed insurance agency, facilitating the sale of insurance products and earning commissions on insurance sold by the Bank and Loan Central. Delivered through Ohio Valley Financial Services and licensed agents.

products.name: Biologic Matrix Products for Soft Tissue Reconstruction
products.description: These are biologic matrices, such as SimpliDerm, primarily human acellular dermal matrices (hADM), manufactured using proprietary decellularization processes and provided in pre-hydrated, terminally sterilized form. They are sold to healthcare facilities for use in plastic and reconstructive surgery, including breast reconstruction and other soft tissue repair procedures.

products.name: Cardiovascular Biologic Matrix Products
products.description: These are porcine small intestinal submucosa extracellular matrix (SIS-ECM) based products, including ProxiCor, VasCure, and Tyke, manufactured and supplied under license, and sold for use in cardiac tissue repair, pericardial closure, and vascular reconstruction. They are distributed to hospitals and healthcare facilities for use by cardiovascular, vascular, and general surgeons.

products.name: Drug-Eluting Biologic Matrix Products (Development Stage)
products.description: These are next-generation biologic scaffolds, such as NXT-41 and NXT-41x, designed for reconstructive and soft tissue repair procedures. They combine biologic matrices with local antibiotic drug delivery, aiming to reduce surgical complications like infection and inflammation. These products are in development and not yet commercially available, pending FDA clearance.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of apartment homes in multifamily communities, involving property management and tenant services. Requires ownership or control of physical real estate assets and in-person management operations.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Development and Redevelopment
products.description: Development and redevelopment of multifamily apartment communities, including construction, renovation, and improvement of properties. Involves regulated infrastructure, physical construction, and compliance with building and zoning laws.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Asset Sales
products.description: Disposition and sale of multifamily real estate assets to external buyers, including institutional and private investors. Involves transactional services and transfer of ownership of physical properties.

products.name: Consumer and Small Business Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive banking services for individuals and small businesses, including checking and savings accounts, digital banking, and branch-based services, delivered through a network of physical branches and digital platforms.

products.name: Consumer and Commercial Lending
products.description: A broad suite of lending products such as commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate and construction loans, residential mortgages, home equity loans, indirect auto loans, credit card lending, and other consumer loans, provided through both digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Deposit products including checking, savings, and money market accounts for consumers, businesses, and municipalities, managed through digital and branch channels and supported by FDIC insurance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth advisory, trust, and retirement services for high-net-worth individuals and institutions, delivered through dedicated advisors and digital platforms.

products.name: Investment Banking and Capital Markets Services
products.description: Investment banking, capital markets, and related advisory services for corporate and institutional clients, including securities underwriting, market making, and capital raising, provided by specialized teams and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Payments and Treasury Management Services
products.description: Payment processing, merchant services, and treasury management solutions for businesses and institutions, leveraging both digital and physical infrastructure to facilitate transactions and manage liquidity.

products.name: Asset Management and Investment Brokerage
products.description: Asset management and investment brokerage services for individuals and institutions, including portfolio management and securities trading, delivered through licensed professionals and digital platforms.

products.name: Specialized Lending and Lease Financing
products.description: Specialized lending and lease financing products tailored to specific industries or client needs, including equipment finance and other niche lending solutions, delivered through dedicated teams and digital channels.

products.name: Marine Construction Services
products.description: Comprehensive engineering and construction of marine infrastructure such as shipyards, dry docks, terminals, berths, marinas, and waterfront facilities, delivered using specialized fleets and technical expertise across the U.S. and select international markets.

products.name: Dredging Services
products.description: Maintenance and capital dredging for ports, waterways, and channels, including deepening, widening, land reclamation, beach nourishment, and erosion control, performed with a fleet of specialty dredges.

products.name: Bridge and Causeway Construction
products.description: Construction, repair, and maintenance of overwater bridges, causeways, and fendering systems, involving deep foundational work with large concrete, pipe, or sheet piles driven into sea or river floors.

products.name: Pipeline and Utility Marine Services
products.description: Installation and removal of underwater pipelines and transmission infrastructure, including industrial intakes, outfalls, river crossings, tie-ins, and related logistics, inspection, maintenance, and repair services.

products.name: Environmental and Coastal Restoration Services
products.description: Construction of environmental protection structures such as levees, erosion control systems, wetlands restoration, and geotube installations for island and shoreline creation, supporting habitat and coastal resilience.

products.name: Specialty Marine Services
products.description: Provision of design, salvage, demolition, surveying, towing, commercial diving, underwater inspection, excavation, and repair services, often supporting other marine projects or serving as entry points for new customers.

products.name: Concrete Construction Services
products.description: Construction of concrete structures for commercial, industrial, multi-family residential, institutional, and public projects, including foundations, tilt-wall structures, elevated systems, and formwork, with self-performed labor and owned equipment.

products.name: Data Center Concrete Construction
products.description: Specialized concrete construction for data centers, including foundations and structural systems, delivered to hyperscale clients with a focus on safety and schedule certainty.

products.name: Industrial, Warehouse, and Distribution Facility Construction
products.description: Construction of concrete foundations, tilt-wall structures, and floors for industrial, warehouse, and large-scale distribution centers, supporting manufacturing and logistics sectors.

products.name: Commercial, Multi-Family, Institutional, and Mixed-Use Concrete Construction
products.description: Concrete construction services for low-, mid-, and high-rise commercial, multi-family residential, industrial, and institutional buildings, including complex elevated systems and formwork.

products.name: Retail, Hospitality, and Recreational Facility Concrete Construction
products.description: Concrete construction for retail centers, hotels, entertainment venues, and sports stadiums, supporting economic and population growth in core markets.

products.name: FILSPARI (sparsentan)
products.description: An oral, once-daily, non-immunosuppressive dual endothelin angiotensin receptor antagonist (DEARA) developed and manufactured for the treatment of rare kidney diseases, specifically approved for primary IgA nephropathy (IgAN) and in late-stage development for focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS). Delivered as a prescription pharmaceutical product, requiring regulated manufacturing and distribution, and subject to REMS for safety monitoring.

products.name: Pegtibatinase
products.description: A novel investigational enzyme replacement therapy for the treatment of classical homocystinuria (HCU), a rare metabolic disorder. Manufactured as a biologic product requiring advanced bioprocessing and administered to patients via injection, pending regulatory approval and currently in Phase 3 clinical trials.

products.name: Thiola and Thiola EC (tiopronin)
products.description: Oral pharmaceutical tablets (original and enteric-coated formulations) for the treatment of cystinuria, a rare genetic cystine transport disorder causing kidney stones. Manufactured and distributed as prescription drugs, with both branded and generic competition in the market.

products.name: Warehouse Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of a broad range of nationally-branded and private-label products, including foods, sundries, fresh foods, non-foods, and seasonal items, through physical membership warehouses. products.description: Online sale of a wide selection of goods and services, including many items not available in warehouses, delivered through company logistics or drop-ship arrangements. E-commerce sites operate in multiple countries and offer convenience and broader selection to members.

products.name: Gasoline Sales
products.description: Retail sale of gasoline to members at stations located primarily within, next to, or near warehouses. Gasoline operations leverage extended hours and high volume to offer competitive prices.

products.name: Pharmacy Services
products.description: Provision of prescription medications and related pharmacy services to members through in-warehouse pharmacies, subject to local regulations.

products.name: Business Center Sales

products.name: Travel Services

products.name: Membership Program
products.description: Sale of annual memberships (Gold Star, Business, Executive) granting access to warehouses, e-commerce, and exclusive member benefits, including rewards and discounts.

products.description: Cloud infrastructure, platform, and application services, including AI-optimized infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, data analytics, and productivity tools, delivered via Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace. products.name: Drug Discovery Services (Isomorphic Labs)

products.name: Digital Marketing and Brand Management Tools

products.description: GoDaddy resells and supports Microsoft 365 and other email services (Titan, Open Xchange), providing domain-specific email, productivity applications, and advanced email security features. products.name: Recorded Music

Delivered through record labels and distributed via digital platforms, physical formats, and licensing to third parties. Involves artist development, label operations, and global distribution partnerships.

products.name: Artist and Songwriter Management Services
products.description: Management services for artists and songwriters, including career development, creative support, and representation. Delivered through dedicated management subsidiaries and teams, primarily in the UK, and involves in-person human labor and industry expertise.

products.name: Music Rights Administration and Licensing Services (MENA)
products.description: Administration and licensing of music rights in the Middle East and North Africa, ensuring rights are fully administered and licensed for global and regional clients. products.description: Products for temperature and humidity control, including thermostats and related devices, primarily manufactured in-house and delivered through professional installers and distributors.

products.name: Water and Air Solutions
products.description: Devices and systems for water and air quality management in residential and commercial spaces, produced via manufacturing and distributed through professional channels.

products.name: Home Safety and Fire Suppression Products
products.description: Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors and fire suppression devices for residential and small business use, manufactured and distributed globally under various brands.

products.name: Security Products and Solutions
products.description: Security systems, including intrusion detection, video cameras, and related devices for residential and small business customers, manufactured and distributed through professional installers and dealers.

products.name: Connected Home Solutions
products.description: Integrated smart home platforms and devices enabling connectivity, control, and automation, leveraging cloud infrastructure and software, delivered digitally and through professional channels.

products.name: Installation and Maintenance Tools
products.description: Specialized tools and equipment for installation and maintenance of HVAC, security, and connected home systems, sold to professional contractors and installers.

products.name: Components for OEMs
products.description: Components such as controls and sensors sold to manufacturers of water heaters, heat pumps, and boilers, produced in-house or sourced from third parties.

products.name: Low-Voltage Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a broad range of third-party and exclusive branded low-voltage products, including security, AV, and related solutions, to professional installers and integrators via the ADI Global Distribution segment.

products.name: Magnetic Sensors
products.description: Spintronic-based sensors, including both standard (catalog) and custom versions, detect magnetic fields to determine position, speed, or rotation. Manufactured using GMR or TMR elements, often combined with integrated circuitry and packaged as integrated circuits. Delivered as small, precise, and reliable components for industrial, medical, and custom applications.

products.name: Spintronic Couplers (Isolators)
products.description: Devices that combine a GMR sensor element and an integrated microscopic coil to transmit data between electronic subsystems while providing electrical isolation. Used primarily in factory automation and power conversion, these are manufactured and packaged similarly to integrated circuits.

products.name: Power Products (Voltage Regulators, Interface ICs, DC-to-DC Converters)
products.description: A line of power management devices including voltage regulators, interface integrated circuits, DC-to-DC converters, and hybrid products that combine couplers and converters. These products are manufactured using spintronic and conventional semiconductor processes and are used for energy conversion and industrial networks.

products.name: MRAM (Magnetoresistive Random Access Memory)
products.description: Spintronic-based nonvolatile memory devices designed for mission-critical storage, tamper prevention, and detection. Manufactured using advanced MRAM cell designs and packaged as integrated circuits, these products are targeted at military, industrial, and security-sensitive applications.

products.name: Athletic Country Club Memberships
products.description: Subscription-based memberships providing access to resort-like athletic country club centers with fitness equipment, pools, courts, group fitness studios, and a wide range of amenities. Delivered through physical locations across the US and Canada, requiring significant real estate and in-person services.

products.name: Personal and Small Group Training Services
products.description: In-person fitness services including dynamic personal training, dynamic stretch, and small group training sessions, delivered by certified fitness professionals within Life Time centers.

products.name: Sports and Racquet Programs
products.description: Access to and programming for tennis, pickleball, basketball, racquetball, squash, and related leagues, tournaments, and coaching, delivered through dedicated indoor and outdoor courts at Life Time centers.

products.name: Aquatics Programs
products.description: Swim lessons, team coaching, and recreational swimming provided through indoor and outdoor pools, requiring specialized facilities and certified instructors.

products.name: Wellness and Spa Services
products.description: In-person spa, medi-spa, physical therapy, chiropractic, and recovery services, including LifeSpa and MIORA offerings, delivered by licensed professionals within Life Time centers.

products.name: Nutrition and Weight Loss Coaching
products.description: Personalized nutrition and weight loss support, including coaching and assessments, delivered both in-person and digitally by registered dietitians and certified professionals.

products.name: Childcare and Kids Programming
products.description: Childcare services and educational programs for children, including Kids Academy, camps, swim lessons, and birthday parties, provided on-site at Life Time centers.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: On-site cafes, bistros, bars, and lounges (LifeCafe), offering food and beverage options to members and guests, often with poolside service, requiring food service infrastructure and staff.

products.name: Digital Fitness and Wellness Platform
products.description: Digital memberships and app-based services including live streaming fitness classes, remote personal training, nutrition support, and wellness content, delivered via Life Time’s integrated digital app.

products.name: Nutritional Supplements and Branded Apparel
products.description: Sales of Life Time branded nutritional supplements and apparel, offered both in-center and through e-commerce platforms.

products.name: Co-working Spaces (Life Time Work)
products.description: Premium co-working spaces located near Life Time centers, offering ergonomic work environments and access to club amenities, delivered through dedicated real estate and facility management.

products.name: Wellness-Oriented Residences (Life Time Living)
products.description: Luxury residential apartments focused on wellness, located near Life Time centers and integrating access to club amenities, delivered through real estate development and management.

products.name: Managed Business Voice and Data Communication Solutions
products.description: Nexxis provides fully managed, integrated business voice (VoIP), internet access, data transport, and SD-WAN solutions engineered for enterprise-grade reliability and cloud performance. These services are delivered via a unified service agreement, with 24×7 monitoring, multi-carrier redundancy, and a single point of management, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person technical support.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining
products.description: Operation of large-scale, vertically integrated bitcoin mining facilities using specialized ASIC miners in both air-cooled and immersion-cooled environments. The company owns and operates its own power infrastructure and facilities to maximize mining efficiency and scale, earning revenue from mining rewards and transaction fees.

products.name: Data Center Leasing Services
products.description: Provision of scalable, power-intensive data center infrastructure and leasing services to external customers, including non-mining workloads such as AI and HPC. The company develops, owns, and operates large-scale data center facilities, offering critical IT load capacity and infrastructure to tenants under long-term lease agreements.

products.name: Power Distribution and Electrical Equipment
products.description: Design, manufacture, and installation of power-distribution equipment and engineered-to-order electrical products for large-scale industrial and governmental customers, including data centers, utilities, and alternative energy markets. These products are manufactured in-house and delivered as turnkey solutions for external clients.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive financial services for individuals and businesses, including full-service brokerage, financial and wealth planning, retirement solutions, insurance and annuity products, education savings, and trust and fiduciary services. Delivered primarily through a network of financial advisors and supported by both transaction-based and fee-based pricing models.

products.name: Investment Advisory and Asset Management Services
products.description: Tailored investment management solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutions, and corporations, including discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management, separately managed accounts, mutual fund managed accounts, alternative investments, and portfolio enhancement programs. Services are delivered via proprietary and third-party investment management platforms and fee-based programs.

products.name: Margin Lending
products.description: Extension of credit to customers, collateralized by securities and cash in the customer's account, to finance securities purchases. Income is generated from interest on such extensions of credit, with lending subject to regulatory margin requirements.

products.name: Investment Banking Services
products.description: Strategic advisory and capital markets services for corporate and public clients, including mergers and acquisitions, equity and debt capital raising, public finance, debt advisory and restructuring, and fund placement. Delivered by specialized industry and product teams, often involving underwriting and placement of securities.

products.name: Institutional Sales and Trading (Equities and Fixed Income)
products.description: Execution, sales, and trading of equity and fixed income securities for institutional clients, including market-making, principal and agency transactions, portfolio and electronic trading, and access to global markets. Supported by research, quantitative and algorithmic trading solutions, and specialized trading desks.

products.name: Equity and Fixed Income Research
products.description: Production and distribution of research reports, notes, and analysis on equity and fixed income securities, including company and industry studies, quantitative and qualitative tools, and research conferences. Delivered by dedicated research analysts to institutional and retail clients.

products.name: Alternative Investments and Private Market Opportunities
products.description: Access to and management of alternative investment products such as hedge funds, private equity funds, fund of funds, and private market investments (including direct, co-investments, and secondary transactions). Offered to high-net-worth and institutional clients, often with Oppenheimer acting as general partner or placement agent.

products.name: Custody, Clearing, and Prime Brokerage Services
products.description: Provision of custody, clearing, and prime brokerage services for hedge funds, family offices, investment advisors, and institutional clients, including settlement, safekeeping, and professional clearing expertise. Delivered through dedicated platforms and operational infrastructure.

products.name: Proprietary Trading and Investment Activities
products.description: Market-making and principal trading in securities to facilitate customer transactions and for investment purposes, including holding positions in investment partnerships and private companies. Exposes the firm's own capital to market risk and is not subject to Volcker Rule restrictions.

products.name: Financial Market Software and Data Solutions
products.description: Provision of cloud-based software-as-a-service solutions for portfolio analytics, transaction analytics, and proprietary data, primarily for institutions and broker-dealers active in fixed income markets. Delivered via BondWave LLC as a technology platform.

products.name: Fixed Telecommunications Services
products.description: Provision of high-speed broadband, data, and voice services to residential, business, and government customers using fiber, fixed wireless, DSL, and hybrid fiber-coaxial networks. Includes video services in select markets and is delivered via extensive terrestrial and submarine fiber infrastructure.

products.name: Carrier Telecommunication Services
products.description: Leasing of network infrastructure such as towers, transport facilities, and fiber routes to other telecommunications providers. Includes wholesale voice, internet connectivity, roaming, site maintenance, and international long-distance services, as well as network build and maintenance for carrier partners.

products.name: Mobile Telecommunications Services
products.description: Provision of mobile voice, messaging, and data services to retail and business customers over owned wireless networks, including the sale of related equipment such as handsets and accessories. Services are delivered via 4G/5G networks and include prepaid and postpaid plans, as well as roaming services for visiting customers.

products.name: Managed IT and Network Services
products.description: Provision of information technology solutions, including network management, application support, and infrastructure services, to enterprise and residential customers. These services complement core telecommunications offerings and are delivered through dedicated IT teams and network operations centers.

products.name: Floating Rate First Mortgage Loans for Transitional Commercial Real Estate (CRE)
products.description: Origination and investment in floating rate first mortgage loans, typically ranging from $15 million to $75 million, secured by middle market transitional commercial real estate properties undergoing redevelopment or repositioning. These loans are structured as bridge financing and are funded over time as borrowers execute their business plans for the properties. Delivery requires significant financial capital, underwriting expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Subordinated and Mezzanine Loans for CRE
products.description: Origination or acquisition of subordinated and mezzanine loans, which are secured by junior mortgages on CRE properties or by pledges of ownership interests in entities owning such properties. These loans provide additional financing layers below the first mortgage and require specialized structuring and risk assessment.

products.name: Takeout Mortgage Loans for CRE
products.description: Origination of mortgage loans intended to refinance or repay transitional bridge loans previously provided by the company. These loans are typically longer-term and are used by borrowers after the completion of property redevelopment or repositioning. Delivery involves underwriting stabilized CRE assets and managing refinancing processes.

products.name: Turbochargers and Air Management Systems
products.description: Manufactured turbochargers, eBoosters, eTurbos, and related air management products for light, commercial, and off-highway vehicles, produced in global manufacturing facilities and delivered to OEMs and tier one suppliers.

products.name: Thermal Management Systems
products.description: Manufactures and supplies thermal systems including emissions systems, cabin heaters, battery heaters, and battery cooling systems, requiring physical manufacturing and regulatory compliance, delivered to OEMs for vehicle propulsion and comfort.

products.name: Transmission and Drivetrain Components
products.description: Produces hydraulic controls, friction and mechanical clutch products, chain systems, torque management products, and variable camshaft phasing, manufactured in global facilities and supplied to OEMs for use in automatic transmissions and drivetrains.

products.name: Electric Propulsion and Power Electronics Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures power electronics (inverters, onboard chargers, DC/DC converters), rotating electric machines (eMotors, generators), integrated drive modules (iDMs), and electronic controls for electric and hybrid vehicles, delivered as integrated systems to OEMs.

products.name: Battery Systems for Electrified Vehicles
products.description: Manufactures high-performance lithium-ion and nickel manganese cobalt battery packs, including proprietary battery management systems, for electrified bus, truck, off-highway, and marine applications, produced in certified facilities and supplied to OEMs and fleet operators.

products.name: Aftermarket Automotive Products
products.description: Supplies replacement parts and systems for light, commercial, and off-highway vehicles to distributors and service providers, leveraging its manufacturing capabilities to serve the global aftermarket.

products.name: Transmission Systems for Material Handling Machinery
products.description: Greenland designs, develops, manufactures, and sells a wide range of transmission systems, including both mechanical and automatic shift, primarily for forklift trucks and other material handling machinery. These are physically manufactured products, assembled from processed metal-based parts and components, and sold directly to OEMs and manufacturers.

products.name: Integrated Powertrains for Electric Forklifts
products.description: Greenland develops and manufactures integrated powertrains that combine electric motor, speed reduction gearbox, and driving axles into a single module for electric forklift trucks. These are advanced, physically manufactured modules designed to simplify OEM assembly and improve efficiency.

products.name: Electric Industrial Heavy Equipment
products.description: Through its HEVI subsidiary, Greenland manufactures and sells all-electric heavy industrial equipment, including lithium-powered wheel loaders, excavators, and forklifts. These are large, physically assembled machines powered by lithium batteries, designed for emission-free operation and sold primarily in the U.S. market.

products.name: Mobile DC Charging Solutions for Electric Vehicles
products.description: Greenland, through HEVI, develops and sells mobile direct current (DC) charging units designed for flexible, on-site charging of electric heavy equipment and compatible DC-powered EVs. These are manufactured hardware products intended to support fleet operations at powered worksites.

products.name: Electric Generation and Distribution Services
products.description: Ameren generates electricity using a diverse portfolio including coal, nuclear, natural gas, hydroelectric, wind, solar, and methane gas facilities, and delivers this electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and public authority customers through regulated distribution networks in Missouri and Illinois. This service requires significant physical infrastructure, regulated operations, and ongoing capital investment in generation and grid assets.

products.name: Electric Transmission Services
products.description: Ameren provides FERC-regulated electric transmission services, moving bulk electricity over high-voltage lines across Missouri and Illinois and connecting with other balancing authority areas. This service involves regulated, capital-intensive infrastructure and is delivered to utilities and wholesale customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Ameren delivers natural gas to residential, commercial, industrial, and transport customers in Missouri and Illinois through regulated distribution networks, sourcing gas from various suppliers and managing storage and transportation. This service requires regulated infrastructure, physical delivery, and compliance with safety and environmental standards.

products.name: Renewable Energy Generation and Credits
products.description: Ameren develops, owns, and operates renewable energy facilities (wind, solar, hydroelectric, methane gas) and sells the generated electricity and associated renewable energy credits (RECs) to meet regulatory requirements and customer demand. This involves physical generation assets and participation in state-mandated credit procurement programs.

products.name: Customer Energy-Efficiency and Demand Response Programs
products.description: Ameren offers energy-efficiency and demand response programs to customers, providing incentives and technology (such as smart meters) to reduce energy consumption and shift demand. These programs are regulated, require investment in technology and customer outreach, and are delivered through utility infrastructure.
